_comment: Phase 10 FSBO CSV intake field-mapping adapter, for manual export/spreadsheet capture of Facebook Marketplace / Zillow FSBO listings. Same first-match-wins, case-insensitive header resolution as config/propwire_field_map.json.
_source_comment: The 'source' column value must say 'facebook' or 'zillow' (case-insensitive) -- anything else is rejected per row rather than guessed. If your capture sheet doesn't have a Source column at all, pass --source facebook or --source zillow on the command line to apply it to every row in the file.
